title: The Board Needs the AI Dependency Map #EnterpriseAI #BoardOversight #AIGovernance #AIProcurement
description:
The board does not need every detail of the AI model diagram.

It needs the dependency map.

When AI becomes material to resilience, cybersecurity, regulated operations, or business continuity, it becomes an oversight issue.

Directors should know where the enterprise has become dependent on AI capabilities shaped by forces outside the contract.

Where does the model run?
Who controls access?
Which cloud region matters?
Can logs and evidence be retained?
Can the workload operate in the right jurisdictions?
What happens if the model is restricted, repriced, degraded, delayed, or no longer approved?

Boards do not need to inspect every root underground.

They need to know which trees the enterprise is leaning on.

From The Sovereign AI Enterprise.

Watch the video here: https://youtu.be/VmSocVYrnH4

Read the full, more detailed Substack article here: https://substack.com/@vladstojanovski/p-202422595
